intro: Estonia is a small tech powerhouse that has produced more start-up 'unicorns' per person than almost anywhere in Europe.

chapters.title: Start-ups
text: Estonian engineers helped build Skype, and companies such as Wise (money transfers) and Bolt (ride-hailing) began there. Forestry, timber and wooden houses are also important exports.

chapters.title: Energy
text: For decades Estonia burned oil shale for electricity, but it is moving to wind and solar power. It uses the euro.

keyTerms.meaning: A start-up company valued at more than a billion US dollars.
